name: build-novel
description: Develop, revise, and prepare novels for publication while preserving the author's canon, voice, and creative freedom.

interface.shortDescription: Develop novels with your voice and canon intact
interface.longDescription: An author-led workflow for ideas, worldbuilding, outlines, drafting, revision, simulated reader panels, translation, and publication preparation. Supports literary experimentation and fantasy, including soft magic and deliberate ambiguity.
defaultPrompt: Help me develop a novel, asking one consequential question at a time.
